CWNContentPack.Title: CWN Content & Icon Pack
Install or update the 64 Harbour City Stories weapons and their colour-coded icons.
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Title: Harbour City Stories Weapon Catalogue
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Intro: Install the complete Harbour City Stories weapon catalogue as World Items. Existing catalogue weapons are updated in place.
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Safe: This operation is safe to rerun. Existing items retain their stable catalogue identity, so updates do not create duplicates.
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Confirm: Foundry will create any missing Harbour City Stories weapons and update existing catalogue items, descriptions, statistics, folders, and managed icons.
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Started: Installing the Harbour City Stories weapon catalogue...
CWNContentPack.Catalogue.Failed: The weapon catalogue could not be installed. Check the browser console for details.
